messages:
Nina: Quick sync — we need the final marketplace private offer structure for the ApexSI + CloudPartner bundle. Goal: sign CP private offer by EOM, align HW SKU credits, lock renewal window.
Samir: Do we have commitment tier thresholds nailed? Finance needs numbers to model Reserved->Metered conversion.
Olivia: Proposed 'three-phase ladder' — pilot (3mo), ramp (6mo), steady (12mo). Each phase has a min commit and a HW credit kicker tied to SKU onboarding velocity.
Ben: Important: billing reconciliation for on-prem appliances is a blocker. Marketplace SKUs vs hardware invoice lines must map 1:1, otherwise SI can't take it to customers.
partnerships-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing checklist due Thu (legal, security, pricing matrix). :bell:
Nina: Suggested discount stack (non-stacking promo rule): commit discount + HW credit only. Example structure below — numbers are placeholders for finance to validate: 
```
tiers:
  - pilot: $50k -> 10% commit discount + $5k HW credit
  - ramp:  $200k -> 15% commit discount + $20k HW credit
  - steady:$600k -> 20% commit discount + $60k HW credit
```
Samir: Two asks for finance: (1) add a conversion clause allowing leftover committed $ to convert to metered at a 12mo lookback; (2) define minimum monthly billing cadence for HW credits. I'll draft the clause.
Olivia: SI enablement: recommend we include 2 enablement sessions + co-marketing webinar as part of the ramp/steady bundles. That materially drives adoption and improves renewal conversion.
Ben: Flag for legal: embargo & joint announcement wording. We need IP language for joint case study and clear channel co-sell rules. Also confirm whether HW credits are refundable or expire at renewal.
Nina: Operational next steps: legal sign-off on NDA/embargo by Wed EOD, finance to confirm tier numbers by Thu, ops to confirm SKU mapping before Friday. I'll assemble a 1-pager term sheet after finance numbers.
Samir: I'll coordinate with billing to ensure SKU mapping and a reconciliation job (monthly) — will post a short spec in #eng-billing after this thread.
Olivia: One more metric to lock: assumed renewal conversion for ramp->steady is 65% — if ops can show evidence higher, we can justify larger HW credit upfront.
Ben: +1 on the metric. Also recommend a short pilot success checklist (2 adoption KPIs) to trigger the ramp credit.
Nina: Great. I'll draft the term sheet and ping legal/finance/ops for signoff. If anyone has objections to the non-stacking rule or the specific percent numbers, speak up now or I'll bake them into the draft. :rocket:
